description: Kenya - Population and Household Dataset is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Demographics, Population", published or maintained by Rhonda Jordan Antoine; Patrick Balla; Laurencia Njagi; Sudeshna Banerjee. (World Bank Group). The dataset contains Population and Household statistics for the years 2009 and 2016 as well as the enumeration areas.The dataset was provided by Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS). Coverage: Kenya. It has 2 files in JSON, SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Demographics, Population. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
